title: Expiration and extension
text:
19.04.060 Expiration and extension.
The approval of a final plat shall remain in effect for a period of three years from the date of approval by the city plan commission, during which period the applicant shall submit any required revisions for approval and record the plat. If the final plat has not been recorded within the three-year period, the final plat approval, unless extended in accordance with Chapter 19.41, shall expire and the applicable plat shall be deemed null and void.
(Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008)
(Ord. No. 18056, § 7, 8-6-2013)
